features: Autonomous Tool Calling: 10 native tools including auto-crafting, inventory inspection, grid arrangement, anvil optimizer, and spatial radar
Multi-LLM Native SSE Streaming: Normalized multi-chunk streaming across Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI backends
Dynamic Custom Tools Engine: Drop uncompiled .js, .yml, or .zip tools into plugins/NSR-AI/custom_tools/ with live hot-reloading (/ai tools reload)
Tool Management Commands: /ai tools to list all tools with version/status, and /ai tools <name> to view full metadata
Interactive Command Approvals: Clickable [APPROVE] and [CANCEL] chat buttons for high-risk actions with 60s expiration
Dual-Tier Memory & Auto-RAG: Personality profile system prompt injection plus auto-RAG for pinned waypoints and notes
(v3.6) Added bStats metrics telemetry (Available publicly on bStats under plugin name 'NSR AI', Plugin ID: 32982).
(v3.8) Improved telemetry accuracy with real-time event capture for AI models, API providers, and response latency distribution.
(v3.9) Added full telemetry support & handler routing for NSR-AI v1.2 and v1.2-pre versions.
Silently resets bug.txt version on startup if the running plugin version is newer than the stored version to avoid redundant bug fix downloads
Updates /ai version bug command output to display the correct plugin version and bug version in the format: NSR-AI [pluginVersion]v bug version is [bugVersion]
Adds support for remote bug fix changelogs, displaying all bug fix details and feature changes asynchronously when using /ai version bug
Adds support for remote security changelogs, displaying all security patch details and feature changes asynchronously when using /ai version security
Fixes the knowledge base system by adding fuzzy/keyword search fallback if no exact match is found
Resolves the admin knowledge key retrieval bug in searchKnowledge() so that admin-only entries are correctly returned
Supports saving and loading database keys containing periods (.) correctly by dynamically adjusting the pathSeparator to a null byte, and self-healing previously nested sections on startup
No bug version is released for this version.
Initial release of NSR-AI v2.0-pre (Utility, Automation & Command Mastery Update)
Added autonomous in-game tool-calling loop (ReAct agent) with 10 native tools
Added Auto-Crafting engine (auto_craft) with recursive parent material breakdown
Added slot-by-slot inventory GUI layout (0-40) and vitals inspection (get_inventory)
Added 360-degree spatial radar (get_world_environment) with 32-block spherical threat detection
Added inventory grid sorting (9-35), hotbar staging (0-8), and equipment handling (inv_arrange)
Added zero-penalty binary merge anvil enchantment sequencing (anvil_enchant_optimizer)
Added multi-command batch execution (execute_command) and interactive security approvals (execute_command_with_approval)
Added dynamic custom tools engine (CustomToolManager) supporting YAML, ES6 JavaScript, folder packages, and ZIPs
Added tool inspection and live hot-reloading commands: /ai tools, /ai tools <name>, /ai tools reload, and /ai reload tools
Added normalized multi-chunk SSE streaming across Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI backends
Added dual-tier long-term player memory (pin_knowledge) with personality prompt injection and auto-RAG spatial waypoints
